RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, meaning sex was not a distinguishing factor in the decision. An all-female panel selecting a female candidate offers no evidence of unlawful sex discrimination, and raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could harm your professional standing.

The announcement indicates the broadcaster prioritized specific digital media expertise over longer traditional tenure. Instead of challenging the panel's makeup, send a polite follow-up request for the written feedback to aid your professional development. If you evaluate fairness, focus on whether the stated criteria aligned with the job specification rather than the sex of the panel.
